verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says its AI Assistants give real-time guidance and suggested responses during conversations. Its API exposes AI-derived call sentiments, topics and summaries, so the suggestion half of the story is covered in-product. Evidence that these insights are surfaced inside the product UI, rather than only through API endpoints, is thin, and all claims are vendor marketing or reference listings. Missing for 10: documented in-product insights or analytics views built from the user's data, in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistants provide real-time guidance and suggested responses, improving performance in every conversation.
